questions.e: Proviso to Rule 48: used packages are disposed of to prevent re-use and pollution.

questions.q: Under Rule 48, PPE for employees handling wastes and effluents is provided:
o: Based on risk assessment and free of charge
questions.e: Rule 48(iv): appropriate PPE based on risk assessment is provided free of charge.

questions.q: At a construction site, where employees are exposed to skin contamination by poisonous or irritating substances, oil, grease or dust, Rule 49 requires:
o: Washing facilities or shower-baths with hot and cold water
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 49(a): sufficient washing facilities or shower-baths supplied with hot and cold water.

questions.q: Rule 50 requires locker facilities for storing clothing worn during working hours and:
o: Special clothing worn at work but not taken home
questions.e: Rule 50(ii): lockers for clothing worn during working hours and for special clothing worn at work but not taken home.

questions.q: Where working clothes are liable to become wet or must be washed between shifts, Rule 51 requires that:
o: Employees bring two sets of clothes
Dry clothes are always available to each employee on return to work
questions.e: Rule 51(iv): arrangements ensure dry clothes are always available on return to work.

questions.q: Under Rule 51, suitable lockers in the changing room are provided for:
o: Separating working clothes from street clothes
questions.e: Rule 51(iii): lockers separate working clothes from street clothes, to avoid contamination.

questions.q: Rule 53 requires a statutory canteen to have:
o: Separate doors for entry and exit
questions.e: Rule 53(v): the canteen has separate doors for entry and exit.

questions.q: Under Rule 53, a portion of the canteen dining hall and service counter is reserved for:
o: Women employees and employees with disabilities
questions.e: Rule 53(viii): a portion is reserved for women employees and persons with disabilities.

questions.q: Under Rule 53, the charges per portion of food and beverages in a canteen must be:
questions.e: Rule 53(xiv): the charges per portion are displayed in the canteen.

questions.q: The Canteen Managing Committee under Rule 53 consists of:
o: An equal number of representatives of workers and employer
questions.e: Rule 53(xv)(b): equal number of worker and employer representatives.

questions.q: Where there is no negotiating union or council, the worker representatives on the Canteen Managing Committee are:
o: Chosen by the workers among themselves
Chosen by lottery by the canteen manager
questions.e: Rule 53(xv)(d): workers choose among themselves where there is no negotiating union or council.

questions.q: Which is NOT listed as a function of the Canteen Managing Committee under Rule 53?
o: Quality and quantity of food stuffs
questions.e: Rule 53(xv)(a) lists quality and quantity of food, menu, meal timings and other relevant matters.

questions.q: Under Rule 53, food waste and garbage from the canteen are to be:
o: Left in the dining hall till evening
Stored in covered containers and disposed of periodically
questions.e: Rule 53(xii): food waste is removed, stored in covered containers and disposed of periodically.

questions.q: Rule 54 requires a notice of first-aid facilities to include:
o: The name and contact of the person in charge and the nearest hospitals
The wages of the first aider
The number of accidents in the year
questions.e: Rule 54(i): the notice gives details of facilities, the person in charge's name and contact, and the nearest hospitals.

questions.q: Where women workers are employed, Rule 54(iv) requires that:
o: Women are exempt from first-aid training
At least one woman worker is trained in first aid
questions.e: Rule 54(iv): wherever women are employed, at least one woman worker is trained in first aid.

questions.q: An injured employee is unable to report the injury to the first-aid certificate holder. Under Rule 54(vi), the duty to report falls on:
o: The person who first comes to know of it
questions.e: Rule 54(vi): the person who first comes to know of it reports it to the first-aid worker or supervisor.

questions.q: Under Rule 54(viii), speedy transport of a seriously injured employee to the nearest hospital should preferably be by:
questions.e: Rule 54(viii): preferably by a proper ambulance van.

questions.q: Which of these is a place in an opencast working where Rule 54(ix) requires a first-aid station?
o: At every shovel or dragline loading point
questions.e: Rule 54(ix)(B)(b) lists shovel or dragline loading points, rest shelters, pumping and refuelling stations, dump yards and places with more than 50 persons.

questions.q: Below ground, Rule 54(ix) requires a first-aid station in or at the entrance to every:
o: District or section of the mine
questions.e: Rule 54(ix)(B)(c)(iii): in or at the entrance to every district or section.

questions.q: Under Rule 54(ix), a first-aid station in a mine is kept in charge of a worker or supervisor holding a first-aid certificate from:
o: Institutes recognised by the Central or State Government
questions.e: Rule 54(ix)(v): a first-aid certificate from institutes recognised by the Central or State Government.

questions.q: Rule 55 requires the ambulance room, as needed by the nature of work, to have:
o: Drenching shower points with drainage sloping away
questions.e: Rule 55(ix): drenching shower points, with drainage sloping away and a secured continuous water supply.

questions.q: Under Rule 55(viii), an ambulance room is provided with Emergency Lighting Supply and:
o: A suitable communication medium, preferably a handheld device
questions.e: Rule 55(viii): emergency lighting and a communication medium, preferably handheld.

questions.q: Under Rule 56, walls and roof of shelters, rest rooms and lunch rooms must be of:
questions.e: Rule 56(iii)(b): walls and roof of suitable heat resisting materials.

questions.q: Under the proviso to Rule 56, motor transport workers must be provided free of charge with:
o: Uniforms, raincoats and other like amenities
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 56: uniforms, raincoats and like amenities free of charge.

questions.q: Under Rule 57, an additional woman welfare officer is appointed where women employed are:
questions.e: Rule 57(i)(b): where women employed exceed 100 and total women do not exceed 1,000, an additional woman welfare officer.

questions.q: The appointment of a welfare officer must be intimated by the employer to the:
questions.e: Rule 57(iii): intimation to the Inspector-cum-Facilitator with qualifications and service conditions.

questions.q: Besides the qualification, Rule 57 requires a welfare officer to know:
o: The language spoken by the majority of the workers
questions.e: Rule 57(ii): knowledge of the language spoken by the majority of the workers.

questions.q: Which of these is a duty of a welfare officer under Rule 57(v)?
o: Acting as liaison officer between management and workers
questions.e: Rule 57(v)(b): bring grievances to management's notice and act as liaison; 57(vi) bars disciplinary and tribunal work.

questions.q: Under Rule 58, wherever required, the employer must provide a:
questions.e: Rule 58(ii): mobile crèche will be provided wherever required.

questions.q: Rule 58 requires the crèche to be provided with a:
questions.e: Rule 58(xxix): a feeding room is provided in the crèche.

questions.q: Under the proviso to Rule 58, an establishment may meet its crèche obligation by:
o: Using a common crèche of government, a municipality, an NGO or a group of establishments
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 58: common crèche facilities may be availed or resources pooled.

questions.q: Under Rule 58, sexual abuse or exploitation in a crèche is dealt with under the:
o: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
questions.e: Rule 58(xxiv) refers to the POCSO Act, 2012.

questions.q: Which helpline numbers does Rule 58 mention for display in the crèche?
questions.e: Rule 58(xxvii) mentions helplines like 112 and 1098, fire services, child protection officer and police station.

questions.q: How often must a plantation conduct mock drills under Rule 59?
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 59: plantations conduct mock drills annually; others quarterly.

questions.q: Under Rule 62, temporary living accommodation for construction workers at remote sites is provided:
questions.e: Rule 62: suitable temporary living accommodation, free of charge.

questions.q: Construction work is done through a contractor and the contractor provides living accommodation to workers. Under Rule 62, the expense is paid by:
questions.e: Rule 62: the principal employer pays the expenses incurred by the contractor on accommodation.

questions.q: Under Rule 63, the medical facilities room or dispensary of a motor transport undertaking must have at least:
questions.e: Rule 63(vi): minimum two rooms, one for staff and medicines, one for emergency, dressing or observation.

questions.q: The illustrative list of equipment for a motor transport medical facilities room is in:
questions.e: Rule 63(ii) refers to Annexure VI.

questions.q: Under Rule 65, the normal working day of a working journalist on a night shift, excluding meals, is at most:
questions.e: Rule 65(3): six hours for a day shift and five and a half hours for a night shift.

questions.q: Under Rule 65(4), a working journalist on a day shift shall not work more than how many hours before an interval of rest?
questions.e: Rule 65(4): four hours on day shift (rest one hour) and three hours on night shift (rest half an hour).

questions.q: Under Rule 65(6), no working journalist shall be employed on a night shift continuously for more than:
questions.e: Rule 65(6): not more than one week at a time or one week in any fourteen days.

questions.q: When a working journalist changes from a night shift to a day shift, the interval between shifts must be at least:
questions.e: Rule 65(7): 24 hours for night to day or vice versa; 12 hours for day to day or night to night.

questions.q: Overtime of a working journalist under Rule 65(5) is compensated by:
o: Equal hours of rest or wages at twice the rate
Wages at one and a half times the rate
questions.e: Rule 65(5): rest equal to overtime hours, or wages at twice the rate.

questions.q: Under Rule 65(2), work by a correspondent beyond how many hours in a week is compensated by rest in the next week?
questions.e: Rule 65(2)(b): work beyond 36 hours in a week is compensated by rest in spells of at least three hours.

questions.q: A working journalist made to attend on a holiday gets a compensatory holiday within:
questions.e: Rule 66(2): within thirty days immediately following, on a mutually agreed day.

questions.q: An application for earned leave by a working journalist, except in urgent cases, is made at least:
o: One month before the leave begins
questions.e: Rule 66(7): not less than one month before, except casual, medical and quarantine leave and urgent cases.

questions.q: A working journalist earns earned leave of not less than one month for every:
questions.e: Rule 66(14)(i): one month for every eleven months spent on duty.

questions.q: Leave on medical certificate for a working journalist is earned at half wages at the rate of one month for every:
questions.e: Rule 66(17)(i): one month for every eighteen months, up to 90 days.

questions.q: Leave on medical certificate of a working journalist stops accruing when it reaches:
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 66(17)(i): ceases at ninety days.

questions.q: Quarantine leave on full wages for a working journalist is normally limited to:
o: 21 days, or 30 days in exceptional cases
questions.e: Rule 66(18)(i): up to twenty-one days, or thirty days in exceptional circumstances.

questions.q: Casual leave of a working journalist can be taken for not more than how many days at one time?
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 66(22)(i): not more than five days at one time, not combined with other leave.

questions.q: On retirement, cash compensation for unavailed earned leave of a working journalist is up to a maximum of:
questions.e: Rule 66(16)(i): up to one hundred and twenty days.

questions.q: Unavailed casual leave of a working journalist at the end of a calendar year is:
questions.e: Rule 66(22)(ii): casual leave is not carried forward.

questions.q: A notice of compensatory holidays for the following month must be displayed:
o: On or before the end of the month in which holidays are lost
At the start of the next year
questions.e: Rule 68(2): on or before the end of the month in which holidays are lost, where the notice of periods of work is displayed.

questions.q: A worker who is not a daily wager earns overtime under Rule 69 when working more than:
questions.e: Rule 69(1)(b): a worker other than a daily wager, for more than forty-eight hours in a week.

questions.q: Overtime wages under Rule 69 are paid:
o: At the end of the year
At the end of each wage period
questions.e: Rule 69(1): overtime is paid at the end of each wage period.

questions.q: Which is listed in Rule 69(4) as a circumstance in which hours under Rule 64 may be exceeded in mines?
o: Loading or unloading of railway wagons, lorries, trucks or ships
questions.e: Rule 69(4)(j): loading or unloading of railway wagons, lorries, trucks or ships.

questions.q: A copy of the notice of periods of work in FORM-XII is sent to the:
o: Chief Labour Commissioner by registered post
Inspector-cum-Facilitator electronically or by speed post
questions.e: Rule 71: displayed on a notice board and a copy sent to the Inspector-cum-Facilitator.

questions.q: Under Rule 72(2), wage slips in FORM XVI are issued:
o: On or before the day of payment of wages
At the end of the year
questions.e: Rule 72(2): electronically, on or before the day of payment of wages.

questions.q: Registers and wage slips maintained under the Code on Wages, 2019 rules are:
o: Deemed to be maintained under the OSH Rules too
Not valid under the OSH Rules
questions.e: Rule 72(3): they are deemed to be maintained under these rules.

questions.q: Establishments covered by EPF and ESI chapters of the Code on Social Security submit a self-declaration in:
questions.e: Rule 72(8): self-declaration in PART-IV of FORM XVII electronically.

questions.q: Under Rule 72(7), manual registers must be legibly entered:
o: In ink, in English or Hindi and the local language, and signed by the employer
questions.e: Rule 72(7)(i): entered in ink in English or Hindi and the local language and signed by the employer.

questions.q: Which is NOT among the items Rule 73 requires on the notice board?
o: Details of accidents for the last five years
Name and address of the Inspector-cum-Facilitator having jurisdiction
Hours of work and wage period
Profit and loss statement of the establishment
questions.e: Rule 73 lists name and address, hours, wage period, date of payment, accidents for five years, Inspector details and unpaid wages date.

questions.q: The annual return in FORM-XVII must reach the Inspector-cum-Facilitator by:
o: The last day of February following the calendar year
questions.e: Rule 74: on or before the last day of February, electronically.

questions.q: The register of leave with wages in FORM-XX is preserved for:
o: Five years after the last entry
questions.e: Rule 76(2): five years after the last entry, and not destroyed unless properly transferred to a new register.

questions.q: When a sample is divided under Rule 77, the person informed is permitted to:
o: Send it to their own laboratory only
Add their own seal and mark
questions.e: Rule 77(2): the Inspector seals and marks the portions and permits the person to add their own seal and mark.

questions.q: Under Rule 77, the first portion of a sample is:
o: Given forthwith to the person informed
questions.e: Rule 77(4)(a): one portion to the person informed, one to the analyst, one retained for court.

questions.q: At each inspection under Rule 78(2), the Inspector-cum-Facilitator ascertains:
o: To what extent shortcomings notified at a previous inspection have been rectified
questions.e: Rule 78(2): checks rectification of earlier shortcomings and compliance with notices.

questions.q: Under Rule 80, the qualifications and duties of experts empanelled for third-party audit and certification are notified by:
o: General or special order of the Central Government
questions.e: Rule 80: a scheme will be notified and qualifications etc. by Central Government order.

questions.q: Under Rule 81, a Medical Officer must be enrolled on:
o: A State medical register under the National Medical Commission Act, 2019
questions.e: Rule 81(1): recognised medical qualification under the NMC Act, 2019, enrolled on a State medical register.

questions.q: Under Rule 82(1), after examining a worker referred to them, the medical officer delivers the age and fitness certificate to:
o: The manager and the worker, keeping a copy
questions.e: Rule 82(1): to the manager of the establishment and the worker, after retaining a copy.

questions.q: Under Rule 82(3), the medical officer may be directed to undertake an occupational health survey where diseases specified in which Schedule of the Code are prevalent?
questions.e: Rule 82(3)(d): diseases as specified in the Third Schedule to the Code.

questions.q: For night work of women, Rule 83 requires the employer to provide:
o: Transport to pick up and drop the employee at her residence
A personal guard for each woman
questions.e: Rule 83(c): adequate transportation to pick up and drop at her residence.

questions.q: Under Rule 83(f), dedicated telephone numbers of the establishment for women working at night must be displayed:
o: At the establishment and inside the vehicles
questions.e: Rule 83(f): at conspicuous places in the establishment and inside the vehicles.

questions.q: For night work of women, Rule 83(h) requires compliance with the:
o: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013
questions.e: Rule 83(h): the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013.

questions.q: Under Rule 85, a contractor seeking a licence must NOT be:
questions.e: Rule 85: not an undischarged insolvent and not convicted in the last two years of an offence punishable with over three months' imprisonment.

questions.q: A contractor must intimate the details of a contract work order within how many days of receiving it?
questions.e: Rule 86(3): within fifteen days, in the manner in Rule 94.

questions.q: Under Rule 86(1), wages of contract labour are paid in accordance with the:
questions.e: Rule 86(1)(ii): wages are paid as per the Code on Wages, 2019.

questions.q: A single multi-State licence application is neither approved nor rejected within 45 days. Under Rule 88(4):
o: It goes to the High Court
It is deemed there is no objection and the licence is auto-generated on the Portal
questions.e: Rule 88(4): beyond 45 days, deemed no objection and auto-generated.

questions.q: Which is a condition of every contractor licence under Rule 89?
o: Wages may be below the Code on Wages rates by agreement
questions.e: Rule 89(2): non-transferable, number cap, fees non-refundable, wages not below fixed rates.

questions.q: Security for a contractor engaging two lakh or more contract labour is:
questions.e: Rule 90(2): Rs. 20 crore for two lakh or more.

questions.q: Security for a contractor engaging one lakh or more but less than 1.5 lakh contract labour is:
questions.e: Rule 90(2): Rs. 10 crore.

questions.q: The licence fee for a contractor engaging 3,000 contract labour is:
questions.e: Rule 90(4)(f): 1,001 to 5,000 contract labour, Rs. 10,000.

questions.q: The licence fee for a contractor engaging more than 20,000 contract labour is:
questions.e: Rule 90(4)(i): exceeding 20,001, Rs. 40,000.

questions.q: The licence fee for a contractor engaging 75 contract labour is:
When a contractor's licence has expired and they apply for a new one, under Rule 90(3) the authority may:
o: Adjust the earlier security deposit against the new application
questions.e: Rule 90(3): the security deposit may be adjusted on request.

questions.q: The fee for renewal of a contractor licence under Rule 91 is:
o: The same as for grant of licence under Rule 90
questions.e: Rule 91(3): renewal fee is the same as the grant fee, plus 25% if applied late.

questions.q: The authority does not renew a contractor's licence within seven days of a valid application. Under Rule 91(4):
o: The licence is deemed issued and auto-generated
The application is sent to the High Court
questions.e: Rule 91(4): failing renewal in seven days, the licence is deemed issued and auto-generated.

questions.q: Where part of the security deposit is ordered forfeited, the balance is refunded to the contractor within:
questions.e: Rule 92(3): the balance is refunded within thirty days of the application.

questions.q: Under Rule 93(4), all contract labour shall be made members of:
o: EPFO and ESIC, subject to applicability under the Code on Social Security
questions.e: Rule 93(4): EPFO and ESIC membership, subject to applicability.

questions.q: A contractor notifies any change in the number of contract labour or conditions of work on the:
questions.e: Rule 93(5): changes are notified on the Shram Suvidha Portal.

questions.q: Which detail is NOT listed in Rule 94 for the intimation of a contract work order?
questions.e: Rule 94(1): principal employer, premises address, commencement date, number of contract labour and duration.

questions.q: After considering a contractor's reply to a show cause notice, the licensing authority revokes or suspends the licence by:
o: A letter to the principal employer only
A speaking order recording the reasons
questions.e: Rule 95(2): a speaking order recording the reasons, communicated electronically or by speed post.

questions.q: A copy of an order revoking or suspending a contractor licence is endorsed to the:
o: Chief Labour Commissioner (Central), Labour Enforcement Officer (Central) and State authorities
questions.e: Rule 95(3) lists the CLC (Central), the LEO (Central) and the State authorities.

questions.q: A contractor amends the licence to reduce the number of contract labour. Under Rule 96(6):
questions.e: Rule 96(6): proportionate deposit is returned if numbers fall, and more is deposited if they rise.

questions.q: The appellate authority under section 52(1) of the Code for contractor licensing is:
questions.e: Rule 97(1): notified by the Central Government from time to time.

questions.q: Under Rule 98(4), wages of contract labour are disbursed:
o: Through bank transfer or electronically, or in currency where that is not practicable
questions.e: Rule 98(4): bank transfer or electronic, else current coins or currency.

questions.q: A notice of wage period and date and time of disbursement of contract labour wages is displayed at the place of work and a copy sent to:
questions.e: Rule 98(6): a copy is sent by the contractor to the principal employer electronically.

questions.q: When the principal employer pays contract labour wages that the contractor failed to pay, it may recover the amount:
o: By deduction from contractor dues, as debt or from the security deposit
questions.e: Rule 98(8): recovery by deduction, as a debt or from the security deposit.

questions.q: The contractor's half-yearly return in FORM-XVIII is sent to the:
questions.e: Rule 98(7): to the Deputy Chief Labour Commissioner (Central) concerned.

questions.q: Before ordering wages to be paid from a contractor's security deposit, the Chief Labour Commissioner (Central):
o: Conducts an inquiry and gives the contractor an opportunity to be heard
Must get the State Government's approval
questions.e: Rule 99(1): an inquiry and an opportunity to be heard.

questions.q: A contractor does not re-furnish the security deposit within fifteen days after wages are paid from it. Under Rule 99(2):
o: The licence is liable to be suspended
The principal employer pays a penalty
questions.e: Rule 99(2): failing to re-furnish within fifteen days, the licence is liable to suspension.

questions.q: A question whether an activity of an establishment is a core activity is decided on application to:
o: The Central Government, which may refer it to a designated authority
questions.e: Rule 101: application to the Central Government, which may refer it to the notified designated authority.

questions.q: The journey allowance to an inter-State migrant worker is given:
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 102(1): once in twelve months.

questions.q: An inter-State migrant worker changed employer midway and has 180 days in the past twelve months counting both employers, without having taken journey allowance. Under Rule 102(2):
o: The present employer pays the allowance on the worker's certificate
questions.e: Rule 102(2): the present employer pays on the basis of the worker's certificate.

questions.q: Under Rule 104, studies to promote safety, health and welfare of inter-State migrant workers are identified by the:
questions.e: Rule 104: the Central Government may identify studies and consult States or expert organisations.

questions.q: For a prospecting excavation (other than coal) to be exempt under Rule 108, its depth must nowhere exceed:
questions.e: Rule 108(1)(i)(b): six metres, or fifteen metres in coal.

questions.q: For exemption under Rule 108(1)(i), no part of a prospecting excavation may extend:
questions.e: Rule 108(1)(i)(c): no part extends below superjacent ground.

questions.q: Notwithstanding the exemption in Rule 108(1), all provisions of the Code may be applied to such a mine by:
o: An order in writing of the Central Government
questions.e: Rule 108(3): the Central Government may by order in writing apply all provisions.

questions.q: Which sand is excluded from the exempt "ordinary sand" in Rule 108?
o: Moulding sand, glass and other mineral sands
questions.e: Rule 108(1)(ii): ordinary sand excludes moulding sand, glass and other mineral sands.

questions.q: Under Rule 110, medical examinations in mines may be carried out by a qualified medical practitioner employed by the mine, one assigned by a group of mines, or:
questions.e: Rule 110(1) lists these three examining authorities.

questions.q: The form of notice for initial medical examination of a person seeking employment in a mine is specified by the:
questions.e: Rule 111(1): in the form specified by the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator.

questions.q: With the notice of periodical medical examination, the employer sends to the examining authority:
o: Previous medical certificates of the person
questions.e: Rule 111(3): previous medical certificates are sent with the notice.

questions.q: A mine worker who failed to appear for medical examination gives an explanation that management finds satisfactory. Under Rule 112(2):
o: They are given another chance to appear
questions.e: Rule 112(2): another chance is given if the explanation is satisfactory.

questions.q: After the medical examination, a copy of the FORM-IX certificate is issued to the person electronically or by speed post and a copy is sent to:
o: The employer of the mine electronically
questions.e: Rule 113(2): to the person and to the employer of the mine.

questions.q: In periodical medical examination, the examining authority sends the previous medical certificates back to:
questions.e: Rule 113(4): previous certificates are returned to the manager.

questions.q: A miner moves to another mine and its manager requests the medical records. Under Rule 114, the former mine's manager must:
o: Send all medical certificates of that person
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 114(1): all medical certificates are sent on request of the new mine's manager.

questions.q: When an examining authority is relieved of medical examination duties, they must transfer all records to:
o: The manager of the mine concerned
questions.e: Rule 114(2): records are transferred to the manager of the mine.

questions.q: Under Rule 116, a woman mine employee is ordinarily medically examined by:
questions.e: Rule 116(1): by a female qualified medical practitioner; if unavailable, a male one in the presence of another woman.

questions.q: An appellant who for reasonable cause fails to appear for re-examination by the appellate medical board is given another notice at least:
questions.e: Rule 117(2)(iii): another notice at least seven days in advance.

questions.q: In the case of a periodical medical examination, the appeal against unfitness is forwarded to the convener of the appellate medical board by the:
questions.e: Rule 117(2)(i): the employer for initial and the manager for periodical examinations.

questions.q: The fee for medical re-examination by the appellate medical board is paid by the:
o: Appellant, as determined by the board
questions.e: Rule 117(3): the appellant pays the fee; it is reimbursed by the employer if found fit (117(4)).

questions.q: The appellate medical board for mines is constituted by the:
questions.e: Rule 118: constituted by the Central Government.

questions.q: The two doctors on the appellate medical board must be qualified in which system of medicine?
questions.e: Rule 118(ii): two allopathic qualified medical practitioners employed by the State or Central Government.

questions.q: After a re-examination by the appellate medical board, a copy of the medical certificate is retained with the:
questions.e: Rule 119(3): a copy is retained with the convener.

questions.q: The appellate medical board examines the appellant according to the standards in:
questions.e: Rule 119(1): standards in FORM-IX; the certificate is issued in FORM-X.

questions.q: Rule 122 exempts certain mine officials from sections 25(1), 26(1), 30 and 31(1) of the Code. These sections deal with:
questions.e: Rule 122: exemptions from hours and limitation of employment.

questions.q: Which of these is exempted under Rule 122 from hours and limitation of employment?
o: Qualified medical practitioner, dresser and compounder
questions.e: Rule 122(vii) lists qualified medical practitioner, dresser, compounder, chemist, assayer, metallurgist and welfare or personnel officer.

questions.q: Where below-ground mines belong to more than one employer, the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator may:
o: Exempt all of them from rescue stations
Make the State Government run the station
Permit or require them to jointly establish common rescue stations
questions.e: First proviso to Rule 123(1): two or more employers may jointly establish common rescue stations.

questions.q: When a rescue station superintendent assumes or relinquishes charge, the employer informs:
o: The Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator and the regional Inspector-cum-Facilitator, the same day
The State Government within a week
questions.e: Rule 123(4): the same day, to the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator and the regional Inspector-cum-Facilitator.

questions.q: Which is a function of a rescue station under Rule 124?
o: Carrying out rescue room functions for below-ground mines with no rescue room
questions.e: Rule 124(iv): rescue room functions where there is no rescue room, besides training and support.

questions.q: One rescue room may serve several mines of the same employer if the mines are within what radius of it and connected by road?
questions.e: Proviso (b) to Rule 125(1): within 35 km and connected by road.

questions.q: A rescue room under Rule 125 is established:
o: On the surface close to the mine entrance
Below ground at the pit bottom
questions.e: Rule 125(1): on surface close to the mine entrance.

questions.q: A rescue room permitted to act as a rescue station for a large group of mines is placed in the charge of a person with the qualifications of:
questions.e: Second proviso to Rule 125(1)(ii): in charge of a person qualified as an instructor, with at least five rescue trained persons.

questions.q: Which is NOT a requirement for appointment as superintendent of a rescue station?
o: First Class Manager's Certificate not restricted to opencast
questions.e: Rule 127: rescue trained, 5 years below ground, First Class Manager's Certificate not restricted to opencast.

questions.q: A rescue station instructor must hold:
o: A Manager's Certificate not restricted to opencast workings
A First Class Manager's Certificate only
questions.e: Rule 128(iii): a Manager's certificate not restricted to opencast workings.

questions.q: Apparatus and equipment at every rescue station and rescue room are as specified by:
o: The Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator by general or special order
questions.e: Rule 131(1): as specified by the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator.

questions.q: At a below-ground mine with no rescue room, the specified rescue apparatus and equipment is kept at:
questions.e: Rule 131(2): maintained at the entrance of the mine.

questions.q: Which of these does NOT need to be of a type approved by the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator under Rule 131(4)?
questions.e: Rule 131(4) lists breathing apparatus, smoke helmets and tube apparatus, reviving apparatus, safety lamps, gas detectors and self-rescuers.

questions.q: An accident at a rescue station arising from use of rescue apparatus is reported within 24 hours by the:
questions.e: Rule 131(7): by the Superintendent, electronically, to the Chief Inspector and Inspector.

questions.q: Under Rule 131(8), the expiry date of absorbent charges, chemicals, self-rescuers and gas detector tubes must be:
questions.e: Rule 131(8): the expiry date is legibly marked on the boxes.

questions.q: The superintendent records the results of inspections and action taken in:
o: A bound paged book or retrievable, non-editable electronic form
questions.e: Rule 132(9): a bound paged book or retrievable and non-editable electronic form.

questions.q: During rescue or recovery work, the superintendent sends to the Inspector-cum-Facilitator or Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator:
o: A daily report, and a complete report within 24 hours of completion
Only a final report after a month
questions.e: Rule 132(8): a daily report and a complete report within twenty-four hours after completion.

questions.q: The course of instruction for initial and refresher rescue training is approved by the:
questions.e: Rule 132(5): courses approved by the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator.

questions.q: An instructor may leave the rescue station only:
o: At the end of the shift freely
With permission of any rescue trained person
With prior permission of the superintendent
questions.e: Rule 133(3): not without prior permission of the superintendent.

questions.q: Which is a duty of a rescue room in-charge under Rule 134?
o: Not allowing unauthorised persons to enter or take out apparatus
questions.e: Rule 134(iv): no unauthorised entry or removal of apparatus.

questions.q: A rescue trained person posted at a rescue station must not leave the station without permission from the:
questions.e: Rule 135(vi): not without the superintendent's permission.

questions.q: A mine has no communication system to its rescue room. Under Rule 137:
o: The Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator may approve other means of communication by order in writing
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 137: the Chief Inspector may approve other means by order in writing.

questions.q: Which item must be shown on rescue tracings under Rule 138?
o: Every water-dam with dimensions and particulars of construction
questions.e: Rule 138(2) lists ventilation features, fire-dams, water-dams, pumping, telephone and ambulance stations and roadways.

questions.q: In a below-ground mine ordinarily employing more than 500 persons, rescue trained persons are required on a scale of:
o: One for every 100 persons or part thereof
questions.e: Rule 139(2): one man for every 100 persons or part thereof.

questions.q: Arrangements for immediately summoning rescue trained persons at a below-ground mine are approved by the:
questions.e: Rule 139(4): effective bell or other arrangements approved by the Inspector-cum-Facilitator.

questions.q: The fitness certificate of a person selected for rescue training is given by:
o: A qualified medical practitioner designated by the manager
questions.e: Rule 140(iii): by a qualified medical practitioner designated by the manager, to standards specified by the Chief Inspector.

questions.q: Who certifies that a person selected for rescue training has sufficient underground experience?
questions.e: Rule 140(ii): certified by the manager.

questions.q: The record of rescue practices kept at every rescue station under Rule 141 must include:
o: The date and character of each practice and the medical condition of each person after it
questions.e: Rule 141(3): date and character of practice, medical condition after practice and other relevant information.

questions.q: A rescue trained person is declared medically unfit at the annual re-examination. Under Rule 142:
o: They are dismissed from the mine
They may appeal to the superintendent and continue
They continue till the next examination
They cease to be a rescue trained person from the date so declared
questions.e: Rule 142: they cease to be a rescue trained person from the date declared unfit.

questions.q: Annual re-examination of rescue trained persons is done to the standard specified in:
questions.e: Rule 142: in accordance with the standard in FORM IX.

questions.q: Which is NOT among the immediate duties of the manager in an emergency under Rule 144(1)?
o: Summon rescue trained persons of the mine
Close all other mines in the district
questions.e: Rule 144(1) lists informing rescue room or station, summoning rescue trained persons, informing nearby mines, summoning medical help and informing the Inspector.

questions.q: Under Rule 144(2), which events are given as examples of a major emergency?
o: Ignition, explosion, underground fire or an accident involving a number of persons
A power cut of one hour
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 144(2) names ignition, explosion, underground fire or an accident involving several persons.

questions.q: The advisory group the manager consults in a major emergency includes a representative of the:
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 144(2): a senior management official and representatives of DGMS, the rescue station and the recognised union.

questions.q: During rescue work, Rule 145(3) requires the employer to provide rescue workers with:
o: Overtime wages at four times the rate
Adequate cool and wholesome drinking water and food
questions.e: Rule 145(3): adequate cool and wholesome drinking water and food.

questions.q: A fresh air base located below ground should, if possible, be connected by telephone to the:
questions.e: Rule 147(1): a base below ground is connected to the surface; a base on the surface to the shaft bottom.

questions.q: Which instrument for measuring humidity is required at a fresh air base under Rule 147(2)?
questions.e: Rule 147(2)(vi): a hygrometer.

questions.q: Which apparatus for testing a gas is required at a fresh air base?
o: Apparatus for testing hydrogen sulphide only
questions.e: Rule 147(2)(v): apparatus for testing carbon monoxide.

questions.q: Waiting to fully equip a fresh air base would put a trapped person's life in danger. Under Rule 147(2):
o: The team must get the Inspector's written permission first
The team must wait in all cases
The rescue team may proceed, since the rule excepts cases where delay may endanger life
questions.e: Rule 147(2) applies except where the delay involved may result in danger to life; the base is then equipped as soon as possible (147(3)).

questions.q: Before a rescue team is sent underground, clear instructions on where to go and what to attempt are given to the leader by:
o: The superintendent or a person authorised
questions.e: Rule 149: by the superintendent or a person authorised.

questions.q: Immediately before entering an irrespirable atmosphere, the rescue team leader must make sure that:
o: All breathing apparatus are working properly
All workers are out of the mine
questions.e: Rule 150(3): the leader checks that all breathing apparatus are working properly.

questions.q: During the journey, the rescue team leader finds a likely roof fall on the roadway. Under Rule 151(1):
o: The leader works alone to secure it
The team does not proceed until the place is made secure
The team turns back to the surface
questions.e: Rule 151(1)(iii): do not proceed further until the team has made the place secure.

questions.q: In smoky atmosphere a lifeline cannot practicably be laid. Under Rule 151(4), the leader must:
o: Send members ahead one by one
Not proceed until every roadway branching off the route is fenced across
questions.e: Rule 151(4): if a lifeline is impracticable, do not proceed until branching roadways are fenced across.

questions.q: The signals used by rescue team members to communicate are specified by the:
questions.e: Rule 152(3): signals as specified by the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator.

questions.q: If the pace is too quick or a member feels distress while travelling with apparatus, Rule 152(4) requires the member to:
o: Call attention to it at once
questions.e: Rule 152(4): at once call attention to the fact.

questions.q: When a mine in emergency seeks help from the nearest rescue room or station, Rule 154 requires the rescue room or station to:
o: Wait for the Chief Inspector's order
Charge an advance fee before helping
Refuse if the mine is not affiliated
questions.e: Rule 154(i): all possible assistance shall be promptly rendered.

questions.q: Under Rule 155, establishing and ensuring proper functioning of the rescue room or rescue station is the responsibility of the:
questions.e: Rule 155: the employer establishes, maintains, appoints persons and provides equipment.

questions.q: Modifications to a mine's training scheme may be required by order in writing of the:
questions.e: Rule 157(2): the Chief Inspector or Inspector may require modification by order.

questions.q: Which is a required element of the mine training scheme under Rule 157(3)?
o: Assessing current competencies and prior learning to establish training needs
Training for the Manager's Certificate exam
questions.e: Rule 157(3)(iv): assessing current competencies and prior learning in establishing training needs.

questions.q: A person already working in another mine joins a new mine. Under Rule 158, the owner ensures the person is given:
o: The additional course of training specified
The full initial training again only
Only refresher training after four years
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 158: such a person gets the additional course of training as specified.

questions.q: The interval of refresher training at a mine may be increased or decreased by:
o: The Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator by order in writing
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 159: the Chief Inspector may increase or decrease the interval by order.

questions.q: A mine may be exempted from the full-day release system for refresher training by:
o: General or special order in writing of the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 160: the Chief Inspector may exempt any mine by order.

questions.q: Under Rule 162, a person must undergo training before re-employment after being involved in:
o: A serious accident or a dangerous occurrence that could have threatened life
questions.e: Rule 162: absence over one year, serious accident or dangerous occurrence, or a different job.

questions.q: Where a group of employers runs a common training centre, Rule 163(2) requires that:
o: They nominate one among them as responsible employer and notify the Chief Inspector and Inspector
Each employer manages it in turn monthly
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 163(2): one is nominated to assume responsibility and gives written notice.

questions.q: Under Rule 163(3), a training centre established under any other law may be approved for mine training by the:
questions.e: Rule 163(3): the Chief Inspector may approve in writing, subject to infrastructure and conditions.

questions.q: The staff, equipment and facilities of every training centre are specified by:
o: The Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator by general or special order
questions.e: Rule 164: as specified by the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator.

questions.q: The training officer of a mine's training centre is appointed by the:
o: Owner or agent of the mine
questions.e: Rule 165(2): the owner or agent, or the owner of the common or approved centre.

questions.q: At the end of every year, a training officer forwards a summary report of work during the year to the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator or Inspector-cum-Facilitator through the:
o: Employer or owner of the common training centre
questions.e: Rule 166(2): through the employer or the owner of the common training centre.

questions.q: Which is a duty of the training officer under Rule 166?
o: Ensuring instructors deliver lectures on standard course material
questions.e: Rule 166(1)(iii): training as per modules and lectures on standard course material.

questions.q: Under the proviso to Rule 167, in special circumstances, who may be called to deliver lectures and demonstrations at a training centre?
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 167: officials may be called from the mines.

questions.q: A trainer for practical training under Rule 168 is authorised by the:
questions.e: Rule 168: an experienced person employed on operations and authorised by the manager.

questions.q: The qualification, training and experience of instructors and trainers are specified by the:
o: Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator on a committee's recommendation
questions.e: Rule 169: as specified by the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator on recommendation of a committee.

questions.q: Under Rule 171(4), every trainer must make sure the trainee is aware of:
o: The escape route from the sections where they will work and other emergency response
The wage rates of all categories
questions.e: Rule 171(4): escape routes and emergency response applicable to the trainee.

questions.q: Under Rule 171(3), persons undergoing practical training must move within the mine:
questions.e: Rule 171(3): trainees move within the mine along with the trainer.

questions.q: Which instructor is entitled to a training allowance under Rule 172(2)?
o: An instructor not under regular appointment at the training centre
questions.e: Rule 172(2): instructors other than those regularly appointed at the centre get an allowance for each day of training.

questions.q: The training officer is not satisfied with a trainee's progress. Under Rule 173(2), the training officer:
o: Reports it to the mine manager, who may arrange further training
questions.e: Rule 173(2): reports to the manager, who may arrange further training.

questions.q: On termination of employment, the training certificates deposited with the manager are:
questions.e: Rule 174(3): returned to the employee.

questions.q: Who may enter, inspect and examine any vocational training centre under Rule 175?
o: The training officer of another mine
questions.e: Rule 175: the Chief Inspector or Inspector.

questions.q: A training centre is closed suddenly due to unforeseen circumstances without the 30 days' notice. Under the proviso to Rule 176, the employer must:
questions.e: Proviso to Rule 176: notice forthwith when closed due to unforeseen circumstances.

questions.q: In an enquiry under Rule 177, the accused pleads guilty. The officer:
o: Imposes penalty in accordance with the Code
Refers the case to a court
questions.e: Rule 177(3)(a): if the accused pleads guilty, penalty is imposed as per the Code.

questions.q: Under Rule 177(8), the enquiry officer may at discretion hear the parties through:
questions.e: Second proviso to Rule 177(8): hearing through video conferencing.

questions.q: When a complaint is re-presented after rectifying defects, the date treated as the date of presentation is:
o: The date of the first hearing
questions.e: Rule 177(12): the date of re-presentation is deemed the date of presentation.

questions.q: The appellate authority under section 111(3) must decide an appeal against the enquiry officer's order within:
o: Sixty days of receipt of appeal
questions.e: Rule 177(14)(ii): within sixty days from receipt of the appeal.

questions.q: Which is NOT required to be recorded by the officer while passing an order under Rule 177(6)?
questions.e: Rule 177(6) lists complaint particulars, parties, offence, pleadings, evidence summary, findings and reasons, and penalty.

questions.q: The medical authority under section 117(2) of the Code (onus as to age) must be enrolled on a:
o: State Medical Register under the NMC Act, 2019
questions.e: Rule 178: recognised qualification under the NMC Act, 2019 and enrolled on a State Medical Register.

questions.q: The inquiry report under Rule 179 must contain conclusive findings along with:
o: The penalty imposed on the manager
questions.e: Rule 179(3): findings with recommendations and suggestions to prevent recurrence.

questions.q: In a dock work inquiry, besides written notice, the competent person may notify concerned persons by:
o: Publishing notice in newspapers circulating in the locality
Notice to the ship's captain only
questions.e: Rule 179(4)(iii): publish notice in one or more newspapers or give other appropriate notice.

questions.q: Which of these is entitled to appear at an inquiry under Rule 180(1)?
o: Any member of the public as of right
questions.e: Rule 180(1)(b): any employers' association or trade union of employees.

questions.q: At an inquiry, a corporate body may be represented by:
o: Its secretary, another appointed officer, or counsel or solicitor

questions.q: Who acts as Secretary to the competent person holding an inquiry under Rule 180?
o: An Inspector-cum-Facilitator nominated by the Central Government

questions.q: A survey committee on safety and health at a workplace may be appointed, on the Central Government's direction, by:
o: DGFASLI, DGMS or another Central institution
questions.e: Rule 181(1): Directorate General OSH, DGMS or any other institution under the Central Government.

questions.q: Compliance with the recommendations of a survey committee report is ensured by the:
questions.e: Rule 181(3): compliance shall be ensured by the Inspector-cum-Facilitator.

questions.q: The compounding notice issued to an accused under Rule 182 is in:
questions.e: Rule 182(1): application in FORM-XXVI, notice in FORM-XXVII.

questions.q: The composition certificate is issued in:
questions.e: Rule 182(3): Part IV of FORM-XXVII; Part III is the application.

questions.q: Where prosecution has already been instituted when an offence is compounded, the compounding officer:
o: Sends a copy of the order to the concerned court
Refers it to the High Court
questions.e: Rule 182(5): sends a copy of the order to the court for further action.

questions.q: Contract labour may submit grievances on health, working conditions and wages at the level of the:
questions.e: Rule 184(1): at the level of the principal employer.

questions.q: The contract labour grievance committee includes representatives of:
o: The principal employer and the contractor
questions.e: Rule 184(2): chairman from the principal employer, with representatives of the principal employer and contractor.

questions.q: Under Rule 186, the substance or quantity of substance for the definition in section 2(1)(zb) of the Code is specified by:
o: General or special order of the Central Government
questions.e: Rule 186: specified through general or special order of the Central Government.

questions.q: Which resuscitation equipment is listed in the general first-aid box under Annexure I?
questions.e: Annexure I item 14: resuscitation equipment such as ambu bag.

questions.q: Which cardiac tablets are listed in the general first-aid box under Annexure I?
questions.e: Annexure I item 15: tablets such as Aspirin and Isosorbide Di-nitrate.

questions.q: Annexure I requires a first-aid box to include one copy of a first-aid leaflet with:
o: Emergency contact numbers of nearby hospitals
questions.e: Annexure I item 17.

questions.q: Which defibrillator is listed among ambulance room equipment in Annexure II?
questions.e: Annexure II item 48: resuscitation equipment such as AED and ambu bag.

questions.q: The IV cannula sizes listed in Annexure II for an ambulance room are:
questions.e: Annexure II item 27.

questions.q: Which stretcher is listed for an ambulance room in Annexure II?
questions.e: Annexure II item 34: scoop stretcher, along with a wheelchair.

questions.q: Which injections are listed for the ambulance room in Annexure II?
o: Atropine, Adrenalin, Hydrocortisone, Furosemide and local anaesthetics
questions.e: Annexure II item 14.

questions.q: Annexure II requires the ambulance room to have a glazed sink with:
questions.e: Annexure II item 1.

questions.q: Which machine is listed in Annexure IV for a mine ambulance room?
questions.e: Annexure IV (xiii)(b): one ECG machine.

questions.q: The glazed sink in a mine ambulance room under Annexure IV has:
o: An infrared sensor for hands-free operation
questions.e: Annexure IV (iv)(a): infrared sensor with integrated soap and paper towel dispenser.

questions.q: The thermometers listed for temperature assessment in a mine ambulance room (Annexure IV) are:
questions.e: Annexure IV (x): non-contact infrared thermometers.

questions.q: Which item in the mine first-aid box (Annexure III) is meant for sprains and strains?
o: Elastic bandages with an ice pack box and ice bags
questions.e: Annexure III (iv)(a).

questions.q: The scissors in a mine first-aid box under Annexure III must have:
questions.e: Annexure III (i)(g): scissors with rounded tips.

questions.q: Which lighting item is listed in the mine first-aid box under Annexure III?
questions.e: Annexure III (vi).

questions.q: A mine first-aid station under Annexure V must have a first-aid box containing materials as prescribed in:
questions.e: Annexure V (iv): first-aid box per Annexure I.

questions.q: Under the FORM IX initial standard, the detailed cardiovascular assessment of employees includes:
o: 12-lead ECG, echocardiography and complete lipid profile
questions.e: FORM IX, circulatory system: 12 leads ECG, echocardiography and complete lipid profile.

questions.q: Under the FORM IX standards, which abdominal investigation report must be normal?
questions.e: FORM IX item 10: ultrasonography (whole abdomen) report shall be normal.

questions.q: Under the FORM IX periodical standard, a hydrocele large enough to impede normal activities means the person:
o: Is fit only for surface work for life
May be declared fit after being successfully operated
questions.e: FORM IX periodical item 20: may be declared fit after being successfully operated.

questions.q: The chest radiograph under the FORM IX periodical standard must be postero-anterior and not less than:
questions.e: FORM IX periodical 8(a): full-sized PA chest radiograph not less than 14 x 11 inches.

questions.q: Under FORM IX, chest radiographs are classified by:
o: A radiologist or medical officer trained in the ILO classification
questions.e: FORM IX periodical 8(a): by a radiologist or medical officer trained in ILO classification.

questions.q: Which liver function parameters must be within normal limits under the FORM IX periodical standard?
questions.e: FORM IX periodical item 17: bilirubin, SGOT and SGPT.

questions.q: Under FORM IX, the person's speech must be:
o: Tested by an ENT specialist only
questions.e: FORM IX periodical item 2: speech must be without serious impediment.

questions.q: Under FORM IX, the spirometry findings for a mine employee must be:
questions.e: FORM IX periodical 8(b): spirometry findings shall be within normal limits.

questions.q: Under the FORM IX initial standard, the limbs, hands, fingers, feet and toes must be:
o: Well formed and developed without deformity, with normal function
questions.e: FORM IX item 9, locomotor system.
